title: List all IIS sites
description: Show every website configured in Internet Information Services with its state, bindings and application pool.

windowsCommandTemplate.name: Get-IISSite
windowsCommandTemplate.commandPattern: Import-Module WebAdministration; Get-IISSite | Select-Object Name, Id, State, @{Name='Bindings';Expression={$_.Bindings.Protocol + '://' + $_.Bindings.BindingInformation}}, @{Name='AppPool';Expression={(Get-ItemProperty "IIS:\Sites\$($_.Name)" -Name applicationPool).Value}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

examples.description: Plain list of every site with its state
List the sites with their physical path

Show every property of the first object returned. Select-Object * widens the output to show all columns. -First 1 limits it to the first result. Use this command to discover the available properties before filtering.

examples.command: Import-Module WebAdministration; Get-IISSite | Export-Csv C:\Temp\Export.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8
examples.description: Export the results to a CSV file usable in Excel. -NoTypeInformation removes the metadata line. -Encoding UTF8 keeps accented characters intact. Useful for archiving, reports and external analysis.
Count the objects returned. Measure-Object returns Count, Sum, Average, Min, Max depending on the properties. Useful for quick statistics and to validate results.

notes: Requires the WebAdministration module. Must run with administrator privileges.

fr.title: Lister tous les sites IIS
fr.description: Affiche la liste complète de tous les sites web configurés dans Internet Information Services avec leur état, bindings et pool d'application associé.
fr.notes: Nécessite le module WebAdministration. Doit être exécuté avec des privilèges administrateur.

examples.Get-Website | Select-Object Name, Physic: Liste les sites avec leur chemin physique
